title: Write Your First Concept
prompt: Define `Numeric` (arithmetic types only) and a constrained `maxOf(a, b)`; provide a fallback `maxOfAny` returning a sentinel for non-numeric pairs.

tests.name: maxOf works on numerics
tests.hint: template <class T> concept Numeric = std::is_arithmetic_v<T>; then maxOf returns b if a < b else a.

tests.name: fallback engages for non-numerics
tests.hint: An unconstrained overload with different arity/types is the fallback — keep maxOf constrained so it never claims non-numerics.
